exact_statement: For every fixed finite pair of Boolean children g,h in a fixed product-biased Fourier basis, lim_{p->0}(J_X-M_X)/(p log2(1/p))=2Z+2E(gh)-2<=1/2-2(E(gh)-1/2)^2<=1/2, where Z=sum_{G_T=0}H_T^2. Equality 1/2 is attained by constant/quarter-defect children and by balanced children after fresh-character multiplication. If child Fourier supports are disjoint then M_X=J_X=h2(p) for every p in (0,1).
hypotheses: common fixed orthonormal product Fourier basis
independent selector with p down to zero
